name: NeuroRoutine Dev
postCreateCommand:
cd frontend && npm install && echo '
NeuroRoutine devcontainer ready. This container only runs the frontend - for the local Postgres/RLS/pgTAP stack, install the Supabase CLI and run "npx supabase start" from backend/ (see backend/README.md). Not chained into this postCreateCommand automatically: it needs Docker-in-Docker, which this devcontainer does not enable.
'
